help.title: Help Center

cancel.q: How can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: If you have purchased an Aura Gold or Elite subscription, you can manage or cancel it at any time to avoid future renewals. To do so, open the Google Play Store app (on Android) or the App Store (on iOS) on your device. Look for the 'Subscriptions' section in your profile, select 'Aura' and tap on 'Cancel subscription'. Keep in mind that you will continue to enjoy the benefits until the end of the current billing period.

gold_benefits.q: What benefits do I get with the Gold plan?
gold_benefits.a: Aura Gold is designed for those who want to elevate their connection experience. By subscribing, you unlock: Unlimited Likes so you never stop, 5 Super Likes per week to stand out from others, 1 free Boost per month to be the top profile in your area, and the 'Rewind' function to recover that profile you passed by mistake. In addition, you will be able to see the full list of people who already like you before swiping.

grace_period.q: How does the grace period and account deletion work?
grace_period.a: When you decide to delete your account from the privacy settings, Aura does not delete your data immediately as a security measure. You enter a 'Grace Period' of 7 calendar days. During this time, your profile remains hidden from the entire community. If you regret it, simply log in before the 7 days are up and your account will be fully restored. If you don't, on the eighth day we will proceed to the physical and permanent deletion of your photos, messages, and data from our servers.

change_age.q: Can I change my name or my date of birth?
change_age.a: To maintain the authenticity and security of our community, Aura does not allow changing the name or date of birth once the account has been verified or created. This prevents impersonation. If you made a serious typo when registering, we recommend deleting the account and creating a new one with the correct data. Remember that age is a critical factor for legal compliance on our platform.

report_harassment.q: What should I do if I suffer harassment or inappropriate behavior?
report_harassment.a: Your safety is the most important thing to us. If someone sends you offensive messages, disrespects you, or violates our rules, report it immediately. You can do it from the chat (flag icon 🚩 in the top corner) or from their profile (Report button). Once sent, our moderation team will review the history anonymously and take measures ranging from a warning to permanent expulsion from the network.

block_user.q: What is the difference between Blocking and Reporting?
block_user.a: Blocking is an immediate and personal action: by blocking someone, both disappear from each other's view and the chat is removed from your list; that person won't know you blocked them, they'll simply stop seeing you. Reporting, on the other hand, sends an alert to our technical team so that we can analyze the user's behavior. We recommend using both options if you feel threatened or if the user is clearly breaking community rules.

missing_match.q: Why don't I see one of my matches anymore?
missing_match.a: There are three main reasons why a match can disappear from your list: 1. The other person has decided to 'unmatch' manually. 2. The other person has deleted their Aura account permanently. 3. The profile has been suspended by our security system due to a rule violation. In any of these cases, for privacy reasons, we do not send a specific notification.

no_notifs.q: I'm not getting notifications for new messages
no_notifs.a: If you've stopped receiving alerts, check the following: First, go to Aura Settings and make sure the 'Messages' and 'Matches' switches are active. Second, check your phone's system settings (Settings > Apps > Aura) and confirm that notification permissions are allowed. On Android devices, also make sure Aura is not in 'Extreme battery saver' mode, as this can delay real-time message delivery.

location_accuracy.q: How does Aura update my location?
location_accuracy.a: Aura uses your device's geolocation services (GPS and Wi-Fi networks) to show you people nearby. Your location is automatically updated every time you open the application. If you move to another city, you will see people from that new area instantly. We do not track your location in the background when the app is closed to protect your privacy and save battery.

verification_process.q: How do I get the verified profile badge?
verification_process.a: The blue verification badge guarantees to others that you are a real person. To get it, go to your profile and look for the 'Verify account' option. The system will ask you to take a 'selfie' following a specific gesture. Our AI will compare that photo with your profile photos in a few minutes. Once approved, the badge will appear next to your name and drastically increase your match rate by generating more trust.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.intro: At Aura, our priority is to create a safe and respectful space for everyone. By using the app, you agree to follow these essential rules to maintain harmony:

items.title: 🤝 Be respectful to others
items.description: Treat others with kindness. We do not tolerate harassment, hate speech, discrimination, or bullying. Be the best version of yourself.

items.title: ✨ Authenticity first
items.description: Use your own photos and real information. Fake profiles, bots, or impersonation are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate expulsion.

items.title: 🚫 No explicit content
items.description: Nudity or sexually explicit content is not allowed. Keep your profile suitable for all audiences. Violation of this rule leads to permanent ban.

items.title: 🛡️ Safety & Integrity
items.description: Do not promote illegal activities or share third-party personal information without consent. Protect your privacy and that of others.

items.title: 📢 No spam or sales
items.description: Aura is for connecting, not selling. Do not use the app for advertising, commercial promotions, scams, or escort services.

rules.footer: Failure to comply with these rules may result in the permanent suspension of your account without prior notice. Help us keep Aura safe by reporting any violations.

safety.title: Safety Center
safety.subtitle: Your safety first
safety.intro: We want your Aura experience to be magical and, above all, safe. Here is a complete guide on how to protect yourself both inside and outside the application.

on_app.title: 💻 Safety on the App
items: Never share financial data, card numbers, or passwords with other users.
Beware of profiles asking for money or 'urgent help' for any reason.
Keep your conversations within Aura until you feel total confidence with the other person.
Use the 'Report' button if someone makes you feel uncomfortable or breaks the rules.

on_date.title: ☕ Safety on Real Dates
items: Always meet in public and crowded places for first meetings.
Inform a friend or family member about where you're going, with whom, and what time you expect to return.
Handle your own transportation: don't depend on the other person to get home.
Stay in control: moderate beverage consumption and don't lose sight of your belongings.

cookies.intro: At Aura, we want to be clear and honest about how we collect and process data about you. This page is designed to inform you about our practices regarding cookies and explain how you can manage them.

card.title: Already know everything you need about cookies and just want to modify your settings?
card.text: No problem. Go into your profile settings in Aura to update the website's cookie settings and head to your account settings in the app to modify your privacy preferences from there.

cookies.intro2: Want to learn more about cookies and how we use them? We'd be happy to explain! Keep reading.
cookies.note: Note: this Cookie Policy does not address how we process your personal information when it is not related to our use of cookies. For more information on how we process your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
cookies.what_are_cookies_text: Cookies are small text files that are sent to or accessed from your web browser or your device's memory. A cookie typically contains the name of the domain (internet location) from which the cookie originated, the 'lifetime' of the cookie (i.e., when it expires), and a randomly generated unique number or similar identifier. A cookie may also contain information about your device, such as user settings, browsing history, and activities performed while using our services.
cookies.q_different_types: Are there different types of cookies?

first_third.title: First-party and third-party cookies
first_third.text: There are first-party and third-party cookies. First-party cookies are placed directly on your device by us. For example, we use first-party cookies to adapt our website to your browser's language preferences and to better understand your use of our website. Third-party cookies are placed on your device by our partners and service providers.

session_persistent.title: Session and persistent cookies
session_persistent.text: There are session cookies and persistent cookies. Session cookies only last until you close your browser. We use session cookies for various reasons, such as to learn more about your use of our website during a single browsing session and to help you use our website more efficiently. Persistent cookies have a longer lifetime and are not automatically deleted when you close your browser.

other_tech.title: What about other tracking technologies, such as web beacons and SDKs?
other_tech.text: Other technologies such as web beacons (also called pixel tags or clear GIFs), tracking URLs, or software development kits (SDKs) are used for similar purposes.

types.summary: For simplicity, in this Cookie Policy, we also refer to these technologies as 'cookies'.

usage.title: What do we use cookies for?
usage.text: Like most online service providers, we use cookies to provide, secure, and improve our services, including remembering your preferences, recognizing you when you visit our website, and personalizing ads.
usage.list_intro: When you use our services, some or all of the following types of cookies may be placed on your device:

necessary.title: Strictly necessary cookies:

performance.title: Performance cookies:
performance.text: These cookies allow us to improve the performance of our website.

marketing.text: These cookies are used to show you relevant ads.

browser.text: You can configure your browser to reject all cookies or to notify you when a cookie is sent.

app.title: App settings:
app.text: You can adjust your privacy preferences in the Aura app settings.

third_party.text: There are third-party tools that allow you to manage cookies.

privacy.main_title: Global Privacy Policy and Data Processing
privacy.intro1: Welcome to Aura. Your privacy is not just a legal obligation for us; it is the fundamental pillar on which we have built our community. This Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.intro2: This Policy applies to all users of the Aura mobile application, our website, our application programming interfaces (APIs), and any other online service operated by Aura App Inc. and its corporate affiliates (collectively, the "Services"). By accessing or using our Services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted the practices described in this document.

s1.title: 1. Exhaustive Information We Collect
s1.intro: To offer a safe and personalized matchmaking service, we collect several categories of data:

sub1.title: 1.1. Information you provide directly and voluntarily

item1.text: When you create an account, we require basic identification information including, but not limited to: your first name or pseudonym, a valid email address, mobile phone number (for SMS verification), date of birth (to verify you are of legal age), and gender.

item2.text: To allow other users to interact with you, we ask you to complete a profile. This includes photos and/or videos of yourself, a written biography, search preferences (age range, distance, gender of interest), your occupation, education level, height, lifestyle habits (such as alcohol or tobacco consumption), religious beliefs, political leanings, and other personal interests. You are solely responsible for the content you choose to make public in your profile.

item3.text: To ensure community safety and prevent fake profiles (catfishing), we implement a verification system. This may require you to submit a real-time "selfie" or a short video. We use facial recognition technology to compare the facial geometry of your selfie with your profile photos. This biometric data is used exclusively for this verification purpose and is deleted from our active servers once the process is complete, generally within 30 days, unless otherwise required by law.

item4.text: We collect the content of text messages, photos, voice notes, and any other material you send to other users through our internal chat system. Although messages are encrypted in transit, we maintain a record of them on our servers for moderation purposes, compliance with our Community Rules, and to collaborate with authorities in case of legal investigations.

item5.text: If you decide to purchase a premium subscription or make in-app purchases, we collect information related to the transaction. Please note that full credit or debit card details are processed directly by our third-party payment service providers (such as Apple App Store or Google Play Store) and we only receive confirmation tokens, purchase history, expiration date, and the last four digits of the card for billing and fraud prevention purposes.

item6.text: If you contact our customer support team, we collect the information you provide during that interaction, including your email address, the content of your complaints or inquiries, any screenshots you attach, and any other data necessary to resolve your case.

sub2.title: 1.2. Information we collect automatically when using our Services

item1.text: We continuously record how you interact with the platform. This includes the date and time of your logins, the features you use, the profiles you visit, who you 'Like', who you dismiss, the 'Super Likes' you send, the time you spend on the application, the websites you visited before or after using our site, and your interactions with advertisements.

item2.text: We collect specific information about the electronic device you use to access Aura. This includes the hardware model, operating system version, unique device identifiers, MAC address, IP address, web browser type and version, language settings, time zone, and data about the mobile network or Wi-Fi connection.

item3.text: With your explicit consent granted through your operating system permissions, we collect your precise geographic location (latitude and longitude) using GPS, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi signals. This information is essential for the core operation of Aura, as it allows us to show you profiles of people who are near you. If you deny this permission, we will collect your approximate location based on your IP address for analytics and legal compliance purposes.

item4.text: We use cookies, web beacons, tracking pixels, software development kits (SDKs), and similar technologies to recognize your device, remember your preferences, analyze site traffic, measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns, and improve safety. You can configure your browser to reject certain cookies, but this could affect the functionality of the Services.

sub3.title: 1.3. Information we receive from third parties

item1.text: If you choose to create your account or log in using third-party platform credentials (such as Facebook, Google, or Apple), we receive information from those platforms subject to their own privacy policies and the permissions you have set there. This generally includes your name, email address, profile photo, and, in some cases, your friend or contact list.

item2.text: We may receive information about you from our marketing and data analytics partners, such as inferred demographics, interests, and your interaction with Aura ads on other websites or apps.

item3.text: We may receive information about you if another user contacts us to file a complaint, report, or claim related to your behavior on the platform.

s2.title: 2. Use of Your Information
s2.intro: We use your data to manage your account, facilitate matches, ensure safety, and improve our services.

sub1.title: 2.1. To manage your account and provide our Services to you (Contract Execution)
items: Create, maintain, and manage your user account.
Provide technical support and respond to your inquiries.
Process your payments, subscriptions, and manage refunds.
Sync your account across multiple devices.

sub2.title: 2.2. To facilitate matching and connection (Contract Execution and Legitimate Interest)
items: Analyze your profile, preferences, and usage behavior using our artificial intelligence algorithms to recommend highly compatible profiles.
Show your profile to other users according to their search preferences.
Enable chat functionality, image sending, and video calls (if available) between users who have made a 'Match'.

sub3.title: 2.3. To ensure safety, prevent fraud, and moderate content (Legitimate Interest and Legal Obligation)
items: Verify your identity and age to ensure you comply with our Terms of Service.

Automatically and manually scan and analyze profiles, photos, and chat messages to detect offensive language, harassment, spam, fraud, child exploitation, non-consensual sexual content, or any other violation of our Community Rules.
Investigate reports made by other users.
Block, suspend, or delete accounts that violate our policies.
Retain data related to suspended accounts to prevent offenders from creating new accounts.

sub4.title: 2.4. For marketing, advertising, and promotions (Consent and Legitimate Interest)
items: Send you emails, push notifications, or SMS messages with offers, discounts, new features, and news about Aura (you can opt out at any time).
Show you personalized advertising inside and outside the app, based on your interests and behavior.
Measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns.
Administer sweepstakes, contests, or surveys in which you choose to participate.

sub5.title: 2.5. For research, development, and continuous improvement (Legitimate Interest)
items: Perform statistical analysis, A/B testing, and market research to understand how users interact with the platform.
Develop new features, products, and services.
Fix software errors (bugs) and improve app stability.

s3.title: 3. How We Share and Disclose Your Information
s3.p1: Aura does not sell your personal information to third parties. However, to operate globally and offer our Services, we need to share certain data with specific entities under strict confidentiality conditions:

sub1.title: 3.1. With other Aura users
sub1.text: The essence of Aura is connecting people. Therefore, the information you include in your public profile (photos, bio, age, approximate distance) will be visible to other users. Be careful with what you choose to share. If you 'Match' with someone, that person will be able to see the messages you send them.

sub2.title: 3.2. With Service Providers and Data Processors
sub2.text: We share information with trusted third-party companies that help us operate our business. These providers are contractually obligated to use your data only for the purposes we specify and to implement security measures equivalent to ours. They include: cloud hosting providers, telemetry tools, customer support services, identity verification, and marketing platforms.

sub3.title: 3.3. With Corporate Affiliates and Subsidiaries
sub3.text: We may share your information with other companies belonging to the same corporate group as Aura App Inc. for centralized data processing purposes, global customer support, and to improve services across all our platforms.

sub4.title: 3.4. For Legal Requirements and Protection of Rights
sub4.text: We may disclose your personal information to government authorities, law enforcement, courts, or private third parties if we believe in good faith that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to comply with the law, investigate fraud, protect physical safety, enforce our terms, or defend Aura against legal claims.

sub5.title: 3.5. In case of Mergers, Acquisitions, or Corporate Transactions
sub5.text: If Aura is involved in a merger, acquisition, restructuring, bankruptcy, or sale of all or part of its assets, your personal information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you before your personal information is transferred and becomes subject to a different privacy policy.

s4.title: 4. International Data Transfers
s4.p1: Aura is a global platform. Your personal information may be transferred to, stored, and processed on servers located in the United States, the European Union, and other countries other than your country of residence. Data protection laws in these countries may differ from those in your jurisdiction.
s4.p2: When we transfer personal data from the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, or Switzerland to other countries, we use legally approved transfer mechanisms, such as the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission, to ensure your data receives an adequate level of protection.

s5.title: 5. Your Privacy Rights
s5.intro: Depending on your location, you have rights such as access, rectification, deletion (right to be forgotten), and data portability.

item1.text: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

item2.text: You can update or correct inaccurate or incomplete information directly from your profile settings in the app.

item3.text: You can request the deletion of your account and your personal data. Please note that we may retain certain information if necessary for legal obligations or legitimate interests (such as preventing banned users from re-registering).

item4.text: You can request to receive your data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

item5.bold: • Right to Restrict or Object to Processing:
item5.text: You can object to us using your data for certain purposes, such as direct marketing.

item6.text: If we process your data based on your consent (such as geolocation), you can withdraw it at any time by changing your device settings.

s5.footer: To exercise any of these rights, you can use the tools available in the application (Settings > Privacy) or contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at privacy@aura-app.com. We will respond to your request within the timeframes established by applicable law.

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.intro: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

item1.text: We retain your data as long as your account is active.

item2.text: If you delete your account, your data will immediately stop being visible in the app. However, we may retain certain information in our backup systems for a limited period (generally up to 3 months) for technical reasons.

item3.text: We may retain specific data (such as device identifiers or email addresses) of accounts that have been suspended for violating our rules, to prevent those users from re-accessing the platform. We also retain data if necessary to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

s7.title: 7. Data Security
s7.p1: We implement cutting-edge technical, administrative, and physical security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption of data in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest, firewalls, strict access controls for our employees, and regular security audits.
s7.p2: However, no system is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information. We urge you to use a strong password, not share your login credentials, and keep your device secure.

s8.title: 8. Children's Privacy
s8.p1: Our Services are strictly restricted to people over 18 years old (or the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction, if older). We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If we discover that a minor has created an account, we will immediately delete it along with all associated data. If you suspect a user is a minor, please report it through the app.

s9.title: 9. Changes to this Privacy Policy
s9.p1: Aura reserves the right to modify this Policy at any time to reflect changes in our practices, technology, or legal requirements. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the app, by email, or via a prominent notice on our website before the changes take effect. Your continued use of the Services after the effective date of the revised Policy constitutes your acceptance of it.

community_rules.title: Community Rules
community_rules.subtitle: Be part of a safe community
community_rules.intro: At Aura, we want to create a safe, respectful, and authentic space for everyone.

authentic.title: Be Authentic
authentic.text: Do not impersonate someone else. Use real photos of yourself and be honest in your profile. Fake accounts or identity theft will be permanently removed.

respect.title: Respect Others
respect.text: We do not tolerate harassment, hate speech, bullying, or discrimination of any kind. Treat your matches with the same respect you would expect to receive.

content.title: Content and Consent
content.text: At Aura we respect personal freedom, but we prioritize consent. The exchange of sexually explicit content is allowed only if it is mutual.
content.important: Important: To send or receive photos, both users must manually activate the "Cameras" option in the chat. If one does not accept, the exchange is blocked. Sending unsolicited explicit content without the other person having activated their permission will result in an immediate ban.

data_protection.title: Data Protection
data_protection.text: We strongly advise you not to share personal information in chats. Revealing your address, phone number, or financial data exposes you to serious risks of fraud or harassment.

spam.title: Spam and Promotion
spam.text: Aura is not a place to sell products, promote your social networks, or carry out scams. Accounts with commercial purposes will be banned.

report.title: See something that breaks the rules?
report.text: Use the "Report" button on the profile or chat. Our moderation team will review the case anonymously to keep the community safe.

hero.title: Your safety is our priority
hero.text: Learn how to protect yourself and enjoy a safe experience both inside and outside of Aura.

chat.title: Keep the chat in Aura
chat.desc: Don't switch to WhatsApp or Telegram too soon. Our moderation system can only protect you if conversations happen within the app.

verify.title: Verify their identity
verify.desc: Look for the blue verification check. If you suspect the photos are fake or from the internet, you can ask for a short video call before the date.

public.title: Public Places
public.desc: Always meet in crowded places (cafes, malls, restaurants). Never agree to go to a private home or an isolated place on the first date.

circle.title: Inform your circle
circle.desc: Send a trusted friend the person's name, where you'll be, and your phone's real-time location.

transport.title: Control your transportation
transport.desc: Don't depend on the other person to pick you up. Have your own means of transportation or use ride-sharing apps so you can leave whenever you want.

golden_rule.title: ⚠️ Golden Rule!
golden_rule.text: NEVER send money via transfer, crypto, or gift cards to someone you just met, no matter how urgent or dramatic their story is.
